historical_b0.checkpoint_policy: reuse exact five historical patient_z_mlp selected checkpoints for validation/test inference

cross_fit.split: KFold(shuffle=True, random_state=42000+outer_fold) over sorted outer-fit patients
cross_fit.nested_validation: within inner-train, RNG(420000+1009*outer_fold+inner_fold), ceil(20%) patients, minimum 6
cross_fit.checkpoint_selection: exact historical B0 validation-patient Macro-F1 threshold selector, max 30 epochs, patience 6 after epoch 6
cross_fit.refit: same B0 architecture, patient-wise z-score, fit-only imputer/scaler, AdamW lr=0.001 wd=0.0001, weighted BCE, patient-batch order, on all inner-train patients for nested-selected epoch count

direct_threshold.prediction_label: EZ iff base_EZ_logit >= predicted_patient_threshold; fixed final probability sigmoid(base_EZ_logit-threshold), classify at 0.5
direct_threshold.target: all classification-equivalent optimal intervals; disconnected optimal intervals retained as a union
direct_threshold.unbounded_interval_clip: [minimum outer-fit OOF EZ logit minus 1, maximum outer-fit OOF EZ logit plus 1]
direct_threshold.global_anchor: negative logit of frozen historical B0 validation-selected NEZ threshold for that outer fold
direct_threshold.descriptor: label-blind score distribution: mean,std,median,MAD,IQR,q05,q10,q20,q25,q40,q50,q60,q75,q80,q90,q95,entropy mean/std,skewness,top/lower tail gaps, fractions within 0.1/0.25/0.5 of global anchor,log1p channel count,evidence count mean/std/min/max
direct_threshold.hidden_ablation: A2 omitted: hidden coordinates of independently trained cross-fit B0 models are not aligned to each other or to the historical final B0 checkpoint; pooled PCA would make a scientifically mismatched descriptor
direct_threshold.learner: standardized linear threshold correction around global anchor, full-batch AdamW lr=0.01 weight_decay=0.01 for 500 fixed steps, zero initialization
direct_threshold.outer_validation_choice: A1 fixed as the sole new deployable candidate; no variant selection on validation outcomes
direct_threshold.outer_test_gate: chosen method mean validation Macro-F1 gain >= 0.01 over A0 AND >=3/5 positive folds AND mean EZ-F1 change >= -0.02

rank_audit.role: retrospective diagnostic only; no trained rank adapter
rank_audit.boundary_reference: absolute base EZ logit distance to frozen fold-specific global B0 threshold
rank_audit.worthwhile: best global rank-mix oracle Macro-F1 >=0.72 OR >=0.015 above B0 threshold oracle, AND EZ-AUPRC and EZ-MRR strictly higher than B0 and Top-1 EZ nonnegative
